27b477f84e.name: user_profile
27b477f84e.sql:
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.Id = e.OwnerUserId) AS user_exists,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM u.CreationDate))/86400.0 AS user_age_days
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = e.OwnerUserId

cb86d816b0.name: activity_counts
cb86d816b0.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table
)
SELECT
  b.OwnerUserId,
  b.timestamp,
  -- posts
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId=b.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS posts_cnt_all,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId=b.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND p.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS posts_cnt_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId=b.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND p.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS posts_cnt_90d,
  -- comments
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS comments_cnt_all,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS comments_cnt_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND c.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS comments_cnt_90d,
  -- votes
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS votes_cnt_all,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS votes_cnt_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=b.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= b.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < b.timestamp) AS votes_cnt_90d
FROM base b

0c3b9af68e.name: recency
0c3b9af68e.sql:
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  -- last activity recency (days)
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT MAX(p.CreationDate) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp)))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_post,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT MAX(c.CreationDate) FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp)))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_comment,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (SELECT MAX(v.CreationDate) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp)))/86400.0 AS days_since_last_vote
FROM eval_table e

92c11c1768.name: activity_windows
92c11c1768.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  -- posts
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days'  AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_365d,
  -- answers vs questions (all time)
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate < e.timestamp AND p.PostTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate < e.timestamp AND p.PostTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_all
FROM e
LEFT JOIN posts p
  ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId
 AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

131e4e8f0e.name: comment_vote_windows
131e4e8f0e.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  -- comments
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d,
  -- votes
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_90d,
  -- vote types (last 90d)
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp AND v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp AND v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_90d
FROM e
LEFT JOIN comments c
  ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN votes v
  ON v.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp

a52ebc5e37.name: recency2
a52ebc5e37.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table),
last_post AS (
  SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, MAX(p.CreationDate) AS last_post_ts
  FROM e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
),
last_comment AS (
  SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, MAX(c.CreationDate) AS last_comment_ts
  FROM e LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
),
last_vote AS (
  SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, MAX(v.CreationDate) AS last_vote_ts
  FROM e LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lp.last_post_ts))/86400.0, 99999) AS days_since_post,
  COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lc.last_comment_ts))/86400.0, 99999) AS days_since_comment,
  COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lv.last_vote_ts))/86400.0, 99999) AS days_since_vote,
  LEAST(COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lp.last_post_ts))/86400.0, 99999),
        COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lc.last_comment_ts))/86400.0, 99999),
        COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lv.last_vote_ts))/86400.0, 99999)) AS days_since_any
FROM e
LEFT JOIN last_post lp USING (OwnerUserId, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN last_comment lc USING (OwnerUserId, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN last_vote lv USING (OwnerUserId, timestamp)

0f28e849e5.name: ratios
0f28e849e5.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_90d
  FROM e
  LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  OwnerUserId, timestamp,
  posts_90d, comments_90d, votes_90d,
  (posts_90d + comments_90d + votes_90d) AS total_actions_90d,
  CASE WHEN (posts_90d + comments_90d + votes_90d) > 0 THEN posts_90d::DOUBLE/(posts_90d+comments_90d+votes_90d) ELSE 0 END AS frac_posts_90d,
  CASE WHEN (posts_90d + comments_90d + votes_90d) > 0 THEN comments_90d::DOUBLE/(posts_90d+comments_90d+votes_90d) ELSE 0 END AS frac_comments_90d,
  CASE WHEN (posts_90d + comments_90d + votes_90d) > 0 THEN votes_90d::DOUBLE/(posts_90d+comments_90d+votes_90d) ELSE 0 END AS frac_votes_90d
FROM agg

b61b1ccca4.name: post_aggregates
b61b1ccca4.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(p.Id) AS posts_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_7d,

  COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(p.CreationDate)))/86400.0, 99999) AS days_since_post
FROM e
LEFT JOIN posts p
  ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId
 AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp

b928dbafbd.name: combined_flags
b928dbafbd.sql:
WITH pa AS (
  SELECT * FROM post_aggregates
), ca AS (
  SELECT * FROM comment_aggregates
), va AS (
  SELECT * FROM vote_aggregates
)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pa.posts_7d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(ca.comments_7d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(va.votes_7d,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_7d,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pa.posts_30d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(ca.comments_30d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(va.votes_30d,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_30d,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)>0 OR COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_90d,
  (COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0) + COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0) + COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)) AS total_actions_90d,
  (COALESCE(pa.posts_30d,0) + COALESCE(ca.comments_30d,0) + COALESCE(va.votes_30d,0)) AS total_actions_30d,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0))>0 THEN COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)::DOUBLE/(COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)) ELSE 0 END AS frac_posts_90d,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0))>0 THEN COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)::DOUBLE/(COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)) ELSE 0 END AS frac_comments_90d,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0))>0 THEN COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)::DOUBLE/(COALESCE(pa.posts_90d,0)+COALESCE(ca.comments_90d,0)+COALESCE(va.votes_90d,0)) ELSE 0 END AS frac_votes_90d,
  CASE
    WHEN LEAST(COALESCE(pa.days_since_post,99999), COALESCE(ca.days_since_comment,99999), COALESCE(va.days_since_vote,99999))=99999 THEN 0
    WHEN COALESCE(pa.days_since_post,99999) <= COALESCE(ca.days_since_comment,99999) AND COALESCE(pa.days_since_post,99999) <= COALESCE(va.days_since_vote,99999) THEN 1
    WHEN COALESCE(ca.days_since_comment,99999) <= COALESCE(pa.days_since_post,99999) AND COALESCE(ca.days_since_comment,99999) <= COALESCE(va.days_since_vote,99999) THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END AS last_activity_type
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN pa ON pa.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND pa.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN ca ON ca.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND ca.timestamp=e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN va ON va.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND va.timestamp=e.timestamp

  -- ratios based on vote counts
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp)::DOUBLE
    / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp) + 1)

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp)::DOUBLE
    / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes v WHERE v.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp) + 1)
    AS vote_vel_90_over_365
FROM eval_table e

1ad23bbf04.name: badges_windows3
1ad23bbf04.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(b.Id) AS badges_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Date < e.timestamp THEN b.Name END) AS badge_names_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' AND b.Date < e.timestamp THEN b.Name END) AS badge_names_365d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class1_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class2_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class3_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class1_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class2_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Date < e.timestamp AND b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_class3_90d,
  COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.timestamp) - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(b.Date)))/86400.0, 99999) AS days_since_badge,
  badges_90d::DOUBLE/(badges_365d+1) AS badge_vel_90_over_365,
  badges_30d::DOUBLE/(badges_90d+1) AS badge_vel_30_over_90
FROM e
LEFT JOIN badges b
  ON b.UserId=e.OwnerUserId
 AND b.Date < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

4808f2e35a.name: comment_vote_windows4
4808f2e35a.sql:
WITH e AS (SELECT OwnerUserId, timestamp FROM eval_table)
SELECT
  e.OwnerUserId,
  e.timestamp,
  -- comments
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d,
  -- votes
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '7 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_365d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN v.PostId END) AS voted_posts_90d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN v.PostId END) AS voted_posts_30d,
  -- velocity ratios computed from same aggregates
  (SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '30 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::DOUBLE
    / (SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1)
    AS vote_vel_30_over_90,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '90 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::DOUBLE
    / (SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp-INTERVAL '365 days' AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 1)
    AS vote_vel_90_over_365
FROM e
LEFT JOIN comments c
  ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN votes v
  ON v.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
